duplicateTheWholeDieStampedGeometry: Duplicate the WHOLE die — stamped geometry + every configuration with its duties and results. The copy starts unlocked.
deleteDieConfigurationsMustBeDeleted: Delete die (configurations must be deleted first)
duplicateCopyThisConfigurationWithAll: Duplicate — copy this configuration with ALL its duties (a starting point for a variant)
downloadTheDatasheetXlsxEveryDuty: Download the datasheet (.xlsx) — every duty in a column, the design and battery blocks, the cross-section, the measured curves and a page explaining each number. Opens in Google Sheets or Excel.
noMotorsAssigned: No motors are assigned to your account yet. Ask MOTRES for access.
lossNotComputed: Loss not computed for this duty.
lossElectromagneticAndMechanical: {em} W electromagnetic + {mech} W bearings and windage
lossElectromagneticUnknownMechanical: Electromagnetic loss only; this run carries no bearings, so mechanical loss is unknown, not zero.
lossMechanicalReadback: mechanical loss read from this duty’s own run
copyThisMachineIntoMyMotors: Copy this machine into MY MOTORS — your private space, visible only to you until you share it
setTheSupplyBatteryDutiesWill: Set the supply battery — duties will be judged against its voltage range
deleteThisConfigurationAndItsDuties: Delete this configuration and its duties
configButtonTip: {config}: loads at its default mode ({duty}); {n} mode(s) saved
defaultModeNumbersTip: Numbers of the default mode ({duty}). Open details for every mode.
configClickBusy: {config}: another load is still running - try again in a moment
configClickNoMode: {config}: no saved mode, nothing to load
configAlreadyLoaded: {config} is already loaded - open Configure to work with it
loadingInBackgroundTip: The view is open already; the motor's data arrive as the load finishes
setDefaultModeTip: Make this the default mode shown in the row
everythingGroupedByStatorDiameterA: Everything grouped by stator diameter. A 🔒 die is a stamped lamination: configurations (stack, wire, winding, materials) live under it, and each configuration has its duty table — click ▶ on a duty to load the whole machine into Simulation. ＋ buttons snapshot the CURRENT state at each level.
catalogUnreachable: The server did not answer; retrying…
propellerCatalogSelect: Select a propeller to view its properties.
picturesDutyTip: Choose the duty shown beside rated in the report field-map pairs. Auto selects the comparison duty. A duty needs stored fields.
deleteSharedDieBody: Removes only your own workspace copy of this shared die, if you have one; the shared die stays for every user. To hide it for everyone, use Retire for all users.
retireRequired: ‘{die}’ is a shared die: deleting it would hide it for every user. Use Retire for all users.
retireDieTip: Hide this shared die for every user. Reversible: Restore brings it back.
retireDieBody: ‘{die}’ disappears from the catalog of {n} account(s) that can see it now, yours included. Nothing is deleted on disk; Restore brings it back. The action is logged in the admin audit.
retireDieBodyUnknown: ‘{die}’ disappears from the catalog of every account that can see it. Nothing is deleted on disk; Restore brings it back. The action is logged in the admin audit.
restoreRetiredTip: Bring back a shared die that was retired for all users.
propellerChartNoThrust: No measured thrust series is available.
propellerChartNoShaft: No shaft curve is available: measured shaft torque or a bounded Cp fit is required.
materialsViewCatalogHelp: Click a card to view its properties and sources.
everyWordMustMatchIdPart: Every word must match: id, part number, maker, description or type.
tick23RowsThenCompare: Tick 2–3 rows, then Compare: fields side by side, differences highlighted.
whereTheNumbersComeFromA: Where the numbers come from. A field without its own badge note is from the first source.
theCardCheckedAgainstAMeasurement: The card checked against a measurement or another source: reference, model, delta.
machineConfigurationsDieConfigThatName: Machine configurations (die / config) that name this card.
dDatasheetMMeasuredEEstimate: D datasheet · M measured · E estimate · ∂ derived · ⚠ to verify. Hover a badge for its note.

applications.label: Application
applications.filterTip: Show only the configurations built for one application.
applications.notSetTip: This configuration has no applications list, so it behaves as before. Set applications in its configuration file.
applications.adminTip: The application each configuration is built for. The first entry is the default.
applications.defaultTip: The default application is the first in the list: the one Configure opens on.

materialsModeActiveTip: The parts the electromagnetic simulation uses
materialsModeFullTip: Every part of the assembled motor, with its material and mass
materialsFullHint: Select a part to inspect its mass and material.
materialsFullHintTip: Materials for active electromagnetic parts are assigned in Active mode.
materialsFullEmTip: Used by the electromagnetic simulation. Change its material in Active mode.
materialsFullNotEmTip: Not used by the electromagnetic simulation. The material you pick is saved with the die.
materialsFullDefaultTip: Documented default. Pick another material to change it.
materialsFullChosenTip: Chosen for this die. Pick the default again to reset.
materialsFullAssumedTip: The default is an assumption (the CAD names no grade).
materialsFullTotalTip: The full assembled motor: the app's active parts + shaft or carrier, holders, rings, bearings, screws, board, pins, enamel. Every per-kg figure divides by it.
materialsFullTotalKitTip: The frameless kit for robots: stator with coils and the phase board + rotor with magnets. Housing, holders, rotor carriers, bearings, shaft, screws and rings are not included. Every per-kg figure divides by it.
materialsFullNoMotor: Load a motor to see its parts.
materialsFullUnavailable: No part list for this motor here.
materialsFullNoCad: Partial mass (no CAD model yet): only the active parts and what the configuration names are listed.
massPartialTip: Partial mass (no CAD model yet): the active parts only.
massFullTip: Full assembled motor mass. Active mass (EM parts): {active} kg.
materialsFullPartialTip: Partial mass (no CAD model yet): the active parts only. It becomes the full mass when the CAD model is built.
materialsFullActiveTip: Iron, copper, magnets and shaft tube: what the electromagnetic simulation and the optimizer use.
